THE CONCEPT

A large-scale social picnic that turns an open field into Egypt's warmest hangout.

Massive shared blankets

Oversized communal picnic setups with cushions, low tables, and room for everyone to sprawl out together.

Live music & big games

Acoustic sets, open mic and DJs, plus giant Jenga, XL card games, and life-size classics for all ages.

Good food, shared

Charcuterie boards, fresh bites, and plates passed hand to hand — the food is just another reason to stay close and keep talking.

Moments from the field

Real photos from real BigNic afternoons — kites in the air, screens lighting up, and golden hour on the grass.

SIGNATURE ACTIVATIONS

Four things every BigNic has in common

01 / GAMES & ACTIVITIES

Giant games, hands-on activities

Towering Jenga blocks, XL card-game showdowns, and paint sessions on the grass — big, hands-on, and impossible to sit out.

02 / FOOD

Charcuterie, pizza & shared plates

Boards laid out across the blankets and fresh pizza passed hand to hand — there's always something good within reach.

03 / MUSIC

Live sets till golden hour fades

DJs and acoustic sets keep the field moving without ever feeling like a concert — just the right volume for talking over.

04 / SOCIALIZING

Strangers in, friends out

Shared blankets and shared tables mean the person next to you rarely stays a stranger for long.
